title: Add a new use case to an existing domain package

domain.x-prompt: What domain does this use case belong to (e.g. shipping)?

verb.description: Verb describing the operation (kebab-case). Example: cancel, dispatch, mark-failed
verb.x-prompt: What is the verb for this use case (e.g. cancel)?

entity.description: Entity name (defaults to domain). Used for class names and parameters.

type.description: Use case shape. action = state transition (e.g. cancel, activate). list = filtered list with cursor pagination.

items.label: update — load + entity update method + save
action — load + entity action method + save (e.g. cancel, activate)

filterField.description: For type=list only: the field name to filter by (default: status).

actionMethod.description: For type=action only: the entity method to call (default: derived from verb, e.g. cancel → cancel()).

fields.description: Optional entity field spec (used when invoked by the domain generator). Example: 'orderId:string,weight:number,address:string?'. When omitted, create/update emit TODO placeholders the developer must fill in.
